results.summary:
I searched the web for Tackform codes. Found 37 codes: 34 codes read on the pages that post them and 3 codes the search reported from pages it returned. 2 codes shown masked or behind a button could not be read, so they were not tested. I tested 37 codes. YG8KW-A37JM is the best: your total drops from $60.00 to $54.00 (you save $6.00, 10% off). It's applied to your cart, and I didn't go to checkout. Conditions seen with it: HotDeals expiry January 21, 2028; Tenere says the source is the email newsletter and the code cannot be combined with ot.

Code	Result	Where it was found
YG8KW-A37JM	saves $6.00, total $54.00	seen on us.hotdeals.com
ARCTIC10	saves $6.00, total $54.00	seen on wethrift.com

Didn't work: NEWQVC25, FITCHECK, FREESHIPPING, 3KSALE, GX-M7019WMNOD, STREETDEAL, RUGGED20, GIFT15, TACKMAS15, REV15 and 25 more.

Code-free offers the pages mention (not tested): $20 off first order discount ... Enjoy a $20 discount on your first order at Tackform!" New customers, first purchase on; 15% Discount for Military Personnel, First Responders, Teachers, and Government Employees" Military discount; no fixed c.

Checkout can still change the final price, for example tax, shipping, or whether the code applies to later orders.
